in_marathi.name: Benu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Made of lotus
in_marathi.long_meaning: Benu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Benu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Benu’, meaning ‘born of a lotus’. It is the name of the celestial goose that holds the sacred scripture, Vedas, in its heart. This name is believed to bestow upon the child a pure and pious soul, just like the lotus flower.
